title: AI Gateway – Elevated errors for Gemini 4 models using Unified Billing
summary: A fix has been implemented and we are monitoring the results.

timeline.body: Cloudflare is investigating elevated errors affecting AI Gateway requests to Gemini 4 models (gemini-4-argon, gemini-4-carbon, gemini-4-hydrogen, gemini-4-neon) routed through Google Vertex AI with Unified Billing. We are working to understand the full impact and mitigate this problem. More updates to follow shortly.
timeline.label: investigating

timeline.body: The issue has been identified and a fix is being implemented.
timeline.label: identified

timeline.body: A fix has been implemented and we are monitoring the results.
timeline.label: monitoring
